summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of the new text overlay tool + shape/ellipse fill + recent colors. 20/29 automated checks passed. Two REAL critical bugs identified: (1) text-commit / text-cancel BUTTONS do not respond to real mouse clicks because the overlay's onPointerDown={startTextDrag} calls setPointerCapture on the parent div, hijacking subsequent pointer events so child buttons never receive a click. Keyboard commit (Enter) and Escape cancel still work, and calling the button's native .click() via DOM works — proving the handler is fine, the pointer capture is the culprit. (2) Live-preview of font family / text size / swatch color while the overlay is OPEN is not wired: changing text-font-select, text-size-input, or clicking a swatch only updates the state used for the NEXT overlay; activeText.{font,size,color} is never mutated, so the currently-visible overlay does NOT update as the review request requires. Drag, Enter-commit, Escape-cancel, shape/ellipse fill toggle, and recent-colors dedupe/max-6 all work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: text-commit (Add) and text-cancel buttons do NOT commit / close on real mouse click. Root cause: overlay div has onPointerDown={startTextDrag} which calls event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(pointerId). The pointer capture on the parent intercepts pointerup/click for the buttons, so their onClick never fires. Confirmed: element.click() via DOM works (overlay closes), page.mouse.click on button coordinates does NOT close overlay.

Live-preview does NOT work while overlay is open. Changing [data-testid=text-font-select] only calls setTextFont; changing [data-testid=text-size-input] only calls setTextSize; clicking a swatch only calls applyColor. None of them mutate activeText.{font,size,color}, so the visible overlay input never updates its font/size/color during editing. Verified: after moving size slider to 90 while overlay open, overlay input fontSize stayed at 32px. After clicking swatch-1 (blue), overlay text color stayed the original pink.

action_items: FIX 1 (buttons not clickable): In Editor.jsx, add onPointerDown={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()} to the text-commit and text-cancel buttons, OR — cleaner — move the startTextDrag / dragText / endTextDrag handlers OFF the .text-overlay parent and ONTO the .text-drag-bar element only. Right now the drag handle already exists so scoping the pointer handlers to just that element is the recommended fix.

FIX 2 (live preview): Wire text-font-select, text-size-input, and swatch clicks so that when activeText is non-null they also update activeText. Suggested change: setTextFont => also do setActiveText(t => t ? {...t, font: value} : t); same for setTextSize and applyColor. Alternatively, drive the overlay input style from the current top-level color/textSize/textFont state instead of a snapshot in activeText.

After the two fixes above, re-verify: change font while overlay open → overlay updates; change size slider → overlay input font-size updates; click swatch-1 → overlay text color changes; click Add / Cancel with mouse → overlay commits / cancels.
critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx line ~982: onPointerDown on .text-overlay wrapper unconditionally starts a drag on ANY pointerdown inside the overlay (buttons, input area, etc). The input already does e.stopPropagation() but the buttons don't, so their clicks get eaten by setPointerCapture on the parent. Preferable to bind pointer handlers only to .text-drag-bar (data-testid=text-drag-handle).

Editor.jsx line ~889 / 897: setTextFont, setTextSize, and applyColor mutate only the 'defaults' state, not the live activeText object, contradicting the review's live-preview requirement. Either (a) render overlay input styles from top-level state (color/textSize/textFont) so they follow the tool state, or (b) also propagate the change into activeText via setActiveText.

Editor.jsx line 424 (dragText baseline compensation): ny adds activeText.size once during drag but the initial x/y come from the raw click point (not baseline-adjusted) — mixing baseline conventions between initial placement and drag may cause the text to drift up by one line the first time you drag. Consider making the baseline offset consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 69% (20/29 checks passed; ~4 of the 9 failures are test-setup artifacts — programmatic input event dispatch and case-sensitive rgb/hex compare — not real bugs)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Working checks (verified PASS): text-tool option-bar (text-size-control, text-font-control, text-size-input with min=10/max=140, text-font-select with 6 options), overlay open on canvas click, overlay contains text-input/text-commit/text-cancel/text-drag-handle, typing updates value, Enter commits + records history 'Text: "Enter test"', Escape cancels with no history entry, drag via text-drag-handle moves overlay left/top style, shape+ellipse Fill toggle produces filled rectangles/ellipses (center pixel matches color) vs outlined when off, recent-colors dedupe keeps max 6 swatches, picker updates color-value chip and swatch-0. After E1 fixes the two bugs, run the same script at /tmp (or reuse the browser_automation script from iteration_13 test run) — specifically re-verify: (1) real mouse click on text-commit / text-cancel closes overlay; (2) size slider / font select / swatch click while overlay open updates overlay input style live.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG 1 RCA: The .text-overlay div wraps the input AND the Add/Cancel buttons. On pointerdown anywhere inside, startTextDrag runs and calls setPointerCapture(pointerId) on the overlay div. Once captured, all subsequent pointer events (including pointerup on the button) are dispatched to the overlay, not the button, so the browser never fires a 'click' on the button. The input escapes this because it has its own onPointerDown stopPropagation; the buttons do not. Repro: text tool → click canvas → type → click Add → overlay stays open. Fix: scope drag handlers to text-drag-handle only, or stopPropagation on the buttons' pointerdown. BUG 2 RCA: activeText is a snapshot taken at overlay-open time. The option-bar controls call setTextFont/setTextSize/applyColor which mutate root state only, not activeText. Repro: open overlay → move size slider → overlay input still uses old size. Fix: also update activeText or drive overlay styles from root state.
